why: Issue #915. A sixth clause excepts one of the touch row's driving controls, which the register files under the `playing` entry rather than as exceptions of their own. Killed by the fold, which asks the register about the three driving controls too and expects null for each. Before the review fix of 2026-10-19 the fold asked only about the controls outside every pane AND outside the touch row, and this mutant passed every test.
killedBy: the accessibility exception register (issue #915) registers exactly five exceptions, each for its reason
